cards.text: The scribes and chief priests know Jesus just told a parable against them, and they want to arrest Him, but they're afraid of the people (Luke 20:19). So they watch Him closely and send spies who pretend to be sincere. Sincere like that call about your car's extended warranty, friend.

cards.question: The spies are only pretending to be sincere. What are they really hoping to do?

cards.text: The plan is to catch Him, then hand Him over to the rule and authority of the governor.
The spies open with praise: “Teacher,” they say, “we know that You speak and teach correctly…” You know that coworker who calls you AMAZING at spreadsheets? Right before he hands you his.

cards.question: After all that praise, the spies bring up Caesar, the Roman emperor. What do they ask Jesus?

answers.text: Is it lawful to pay taxes to him
Is it lawful to bow down to him
Is it lawful to fight against him

cards.question: Jesus sees through the spies' act.

cards.text: Jesus asks the spies to show Him a denarius. Me, I'd have fallen for it: one nice word about my mustache and I'm packing you a cookie box.

cards.question: Jesus asks the spies whose image and inscription are on the denarius. Their answer: ___.
Caesar's image is on the spies' coin. So what does Jesus tell them?

answers.text: Give Caesar what is his and God what is His
Give Caesar nothing and give God everything
Give God first and Caesar what is left over

cards.text: And all of this is happening right in front of the people. A live audience, friend, and NO retakes.

cards.question: The spies manage to trap Jesus in His words in front of the people.

cards.text: Amazed at His answer, the spies fall silent. All that sweet talk, and now not ONE word.
Then some Sadducees, a Jewish group, come to question Jesus. Round two, friend: DING DING!

cards.question: The Sadducees say there is no resurrection.

cards.text: They start with something Moses, Israel's leader, wrote about a man whose brother dies and leaves a wife but no children.

cards.question: According to what Moses wrote, what is the living brother supposed to do?

answers.text: Marry the widow and raise children for his brother
Look after the widow until she marries again
Give the widow his brother's land and house

cards.text: Then the Sadducees tell Jesus about SEVEN brothers. Friend, when a story starts with seven brothers, clear your whole afternoon.
The first one marries a wife but dies childless. Then the second and the third marry the widow.

cards.question: In the Sadducees' story, all seven brothers marry the same widow. How many of the seven leave children?
Last of all, the woman dies. Then the Sadducees ask their big question: in the resurrection, whose ___ will she be?

cards.text: Jesus answers, “The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.” Notice that, friend: THIS age.

cards.question: Jesus says those considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection will still marry.
Jesus says those in the resurrection can no longer die. Why?

answers.text: Because they are like the angels
Because they never sinned on earth
Because they live far from the earth

cards.question: Jesus calls those in the resurrection sons of God.

cards.text: Then Jesus says even Moses shows that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. The SAME Moses the Sadducees just quoted? That's your own screenshot coming right back at you, friend.

There Moses calls the Lord “the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Those three forefathers of Israel had already died, and He's STILL called their God (Genesis 25:8; 35:29; 49:33).

cards.question: Jesus says the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob is not the God of the dead, but of the ___.

cards.text: Some of the scribes answer, “Teacher, You have spoken well!” The SCRIBES said that, friend, and I nearly dropped a whole tray of cookies.

cards.question: After Jesus' answer, how do His challengers respond?

answers.text: They don't dare question Him any further
They bring Him an even harder riddle
They ask Him to show them a sign
